criteria.name: synthetic_known_truth_gate
criteria.interpretation: The internal gate blocks unsupported known-truth overclaims.

criteria.name: threshold_limits_reported
criteria.interpretation: Thresholds have safe regions, but dangerous regions must be reported.

criteria.name: uncertainty_blocks_unsupported_support
criteria.interpretation: Uncertainty is conservative and does not turn unsupported claims into support.

criteria.name: scifact_external_claim_control
criteria.interpretation: SciFact supports an external claim-auditing case, not SOTA verification.

criteria.name: tuebingen_causal_overclaim_control
criteria.interpretation: Tuebingen supports causal overclaim auditing, not causal-discovery performance.

criteria.name: manuscript_claim_audit
criteria.interpretation: The current manuscript wording passes executable claim-boundary checks.

criteria.name: component_ablation_nonredundancy
criteria.interpretation: Core components are non-redundant because ablations reintroduce risks.

criteria.name: reviewer_attack_suite
criteria.interpretation: Reviewer attacks pass with explicit reportable limits.

criteria.name: clean_release
criteria.interpretation: The tracked artifact package is internally reproducible.

publishable_claim: ClaimBench v2 is a claim-aware auditing framework that separates prediction, evidence retrieval, causal direction, uncertainty, manuscript wording, and release reproducibility. It is not a SciFact SOTA system and not a causal-discovery performance method.
